title: A Work queue task shows the decisions it rests on: Attach a decision, ✎ to detach
why: Jason, 2026-11-24: "need task to show what ADR is attached to it or have the ability to look and assign adrs"; then "build these two decisions please. 1. scope. then 2. adrs". On the task's page (task-scope) and the admin's own list of decisions (System Configuration → Decisions). Reviewed by the Design reviewer and the session manager.

changes.what: A task's page lists the decisions attached to it, number and title, each opening on System Configuration → Decisions beside the board
Attach a decision: find one by its number or a word in its title, in the Decisions page's own list; one already attached is greyed, saying so
✎ detaches one (untick), each change in the task's History; the queue's row names its decisions
FAQ: the Work queue's answer says how to attach a decision
